pb-narration.title: Narration desk
pb-narration.intro: Prepare the source, approve each paid voice request, then listen before delivery.
pb-narration.rehearsal: This rehearsal uses synthetic examples. It does not call a provider or prove speech quality.
pb-narration.destinationHelp: Distributor upload stays with you. Technical checks do not guarantee acceptance. Unqualified routes refuse.
pb-narration.sourceDirty: Source choices changed. Prepare the current source before approving audio.
pb-narration.private: Private text stays here. Cloud speech and AI are blocked until qualified local routes exist.
pb-narration.public: Your exact text leaves this device only after you approve its request.
pb-narration.legal: Paid client production and exports wait for a named lawyer to confirm the rights rule. Prepare and review the manuscript meanwhile.
pb-narration.connectionHelp: Use your Google Cloud key with billing and speech enabled. Saving it makes no test call. Never use a shared key.
pb-narration.markupHelp: Keep every word. Add a pause directive after text; licensed voice and language directives are also checked.
pb-narration.previewHelp: Review this exact source request before the configured model receives it.
pb-narration.quoteHelp: This approval binds this text, voice, account and rate once. A changed source or account needs a fresh quote.
pb-narration.quoteFormula: Characters multiplied by the dated provider rate, rounded up in micro units. An owner rate overrides the list price for reservation.
pb-narration.listenHelp: Play the actual current audio. Check pronunciation, stress and pacing yourself.
pb-narration.verdict.approved: Word check passed. Owner listening is still required.
pb-narration.verdict.retry: Make this segment again. Listening cannot override this result.
pb-narration.timing: Timing is measured at speech intervals, not individual words. Tone and stress are not automatically checked.
pb-narration.listened: I listened to this current audio
pb-narration.master: Make and check the final audio
pb-narration.masterHelp: A new master needs fresh listening. Missing measurements never pass.
pb-narration.unknown: A previous request may have been charged. Check the provider usage and keep this job for reconciliation. No automatic retry.
pb-narration.deliveryHelp: Every current segment needs measured final audio and owner listening. AI narration disclosure travels with the files. Upload them yourself.
pb-narration.downloadHelp: Review these files and save them. Nothing was submitted to a distributor.
pb-narration.feeHelp: Uses your recorded hourly rate. Before tax or discounts; no invoice or order price was changed.
pb-narration.feeFormula: Owner hourly minor units multiplied by measured milliseconds, divided by milliseconds per hour, rounded half up.
pb-narration.stale: Source, rights or audio changed. Review the current source before continuing.
pb-narration.loadError: This job could not be refreshed. Try again before approving anything.
pb-narration.fetchHelp: Approve this exact public page read. Site terms and robots rules still apply. No signed-in or private page access.
pb-narration.check.head: Leading room tone
pb-narration.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This step could not finish. Refresh the job and try again.
pb-narration.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: Paid client production and exports wait for a named lawyer to confirm the rights rule. Prepare and review the manuscript meanwhile.
pb-narration.error.DERIVED_STALE: Source, rights or audio changed. Review the current source before continuing.
pb-narration.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The job or approval changed. Review the current version.
pb-narration.error.PRIVATE_NEEDS_LOCAL: Private text stays here. Cloud speech and AI are blocked until qualified local routes exist.
pb-narration.error.NARRATION_OUTCOME_UNK: A previous request may have been charged. Check the provider usage and keep this job for reconciliation. No automatic retry.
pb-narration.error.NARRATION_DISTRIBUTOR: This distributor route is not qualified for synthetic narration. Choose client delivery or Spotify.
pb-narration.error.NARRATION_MARKUP_SOUR: Keep every exact source word and segment in order.
pb-narration.error.NARRATION_MARKUP_INVA: Use supported licensed voices, languages and bounded pauses.
pb-narration.error.NARRATION_APPROVAL_RE: Verify, master and listen to every current segment first.
pb-narration.error.NARRATION_AUDIO_EXIST: Keep existing audio with its original source. Replace the source explicitly for a new job version.
pb-narration.error.NARRATION_SOURCE_REQU: Choose a readable manuscript attached to this order.
pb-narration.error.RIGHTS_REQUIRED: Record current ownership or a written licence covering narration.
pb-narration.error.SPEECH_PLANNED: Save your Google Cloud speech account first.
pb-narration.error.TRANSCRIBE_NOT_AVAILA: Local ffmpeg and whisper.cpp must be installed and ready. Install them yourself, then try again.
pb-narration.error.TIER_UNAVAILABLE: Audio measurement and mastering need the desktop app.
pb-narration.error.UPLOAD_LIMIT: Choose a file within the upload limit.
pb-narration.error.UNSUPPORTED_UPLOAD: Choose readable text, Markdown or a valid Word document.
pb-narration.error.FETCH_POLICY_REFUSED: This site does not permit automated reading. Use an authorized manuscript instead.
pb-narration.error.EXPLAINER_QUOTE_REQUI: Select exact, ordered plain source words without added claims or markup.
pb-narration.error.NO_MODEL_CONNECTED: Connect a configured model in Your AI first.
pb-narration.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQUE: Check the requested fields and try again.
pb-narration.rehearsalRender: This browser rehearsal cannot render the selected reel. Use desktop ffmpeg with the real source and approved audio.
pb-narration.listenApproved: The owner has approved this exact current audio after listening.
